title: FRED Market Fear Gauges Pro
description: Pro-tier variant of fred_fear_gauges. Keeps the same five FRED series (VIX, HY spread, IG spread, STLFSI2, dollar index) but fetches 5 years of daily history per series (limit=1250) instead of 5 points. Computes percentile_rank within that history, rolling z-score vs a 1-year mean/std, and a regime label derived from the percentile (CALM/NORMAL/ELEVATED/STRESSED/CRISIS). Rolls up to one row per metric (same shape as the sandboxed variant) so it drops into the existing alert-group feeder. trust_level: unrestricted - requires scipy.stats.
code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from scipy import stats

BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations'
API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('FRED_API_KEY', '')
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

SERIES = [
    ('VIXCLS', 'vix', 'CBOE Volatility Index (VIX)'),
    ('BAMLH0A0HYM2', 'hy_spread', 'ICE BofA US High Yield Option-Adjusted Spread'),
    ('BAMLC0A0CM', 'ig_spread', 'ICE BofA US Corporate Index Option-Adjusted Spread'),
    ('STLFSI2', 'stress_index', 'St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index'),
    ('DTWEXBGS', 'dollar_index', 'Trade Weighted U.S. Dollar Index (Broad Goods & Services)'),
]

rows = []
for series_id, label, description in SERIES:
    resp = requests.get(
        BASE,
        params={
            'series_id': series_id,
            'api_key': API_KEY,
            'file_type': 'json',
            'sort_order': 'desc',
            'limit': 1250,  # ~5 years of daily observations
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    obs = resp.json().get('observations', [])

    values_with_dates = []
    for o in obs:
        v = o.get('value', '.')
        if v != '.':
            try:
                values_with_dates.append((o.get('date', ''), float(v)))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                continue
    if not values_with_dates:
        continue

    # observations arrive desc-sorted; position 0 is the latest
    latest_date, latest = values_with_dates[0]
    prev = values_with_dates[1][1] if len(values_with_dates) >= 2 else latest
    change = round(latest - prev, 4)
    change_pct = round(((latest - prev) / prev) * 100, 2) if prev != 0 else 0.0

    values_arr = np.array([v for _, v in values_with_dates], dtype=float)

    # Percentile rank of the latest value over the full 5y history
    sorted_vals = np.sort(values_arr)
    pct_rank = float((np.searchsorted(sorted_vals, latest) / max(len(sorted_vals), 1)) * 100.0)

    # Rolling 1-year window z-score (252 trading days when available)
    window = values_arr[:252] if len(values_arr) >= 252 else values_arr
    mean_1y = float(np.mean(window))
    std_1y = float(np.std(window, ddof=1)) if len(window) > 1 else 0.0
    z_score = ((latest - mean_1y) / std_1y) if std_1y > 0 else 0.0

    # Regime from percentile rank (higher = more stress for all series except stress_index which is already directional)
    if pct_rank >= 95:
        regime = 'CRISIS'
    elif pct_rank >= 80:
        regime = 'STRESSED'
    elif pct_rank >= 60:
        regime = 'ELEVATED'
    elif pct_rank >= 30:
        regime = 'NORMAL'
    else:
        regime = 'CALM'

    # Preserve base script's fear_level logic so saved searches keep working
    if label == 'vix':
        if latest > 35:
            fear_level = 'EXTREME_FEAR'
        elif latest > 25:
            fear_level = 'HIGH_FEAR'
        elif latest > 18:
            fear_level = 'ELEVATED'
        elif latest > 12:
            fear_level = 'NORMAL'
        else:
            fear_level = 'COMPLACENCY'
    elif label == 'hy_spread':
        if latest > 600:
            fear_level = 'CRISIS'
        elif latest > 450:
            fear_level = 'HIGH_STRESS'
        elif latest > 350:
            fear_level = 'ELEVATED'
        else:
            fear_level = 'NORMAL'
    elif label == 'stress_index':
        if latest > 1.5:
            fear_level = 'HIGH_STRESS'
        elif latest > 0.5:
            fear_level = 'ELEVATED'
        elif latest > -0.5:
            fear_level = 'NORMAL'
        else:
            fear_level = 'CALM'
    else:
        fear_level = 'RISING' if change > 0 else 'FALLING'

    rows.append({
        'series_id': series_id,
        'metric': label,
        'description': description,
        'latest_value': latest,
        'latest_date': latest_date,
        'prior_value': prev,
        'change': change,
        'change_pct': change_pct,
        'fear_level': fear_level,
        # Pro additions:
        'percentile_rank': round(pct_rank, 2),
        'z_score_1y': round(z_score, 3),
        'mean_1y': round(mean_1y, 4),
        'std_1y': round(std_1y, 4),
        'history_points': len(values_arr),
        'regime': regime,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
